args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece accessible via free email registration (no password).
• Article (blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.ironbark.example, registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
